## C. Evidence posture

The worker recovered live GitHub `main` at `Levi-Anthony/ecb-v2@6ad0e558921a765b02a7dffbb8b11ce3d862020c` and live Linear sources. Load-bearing sources included <issue id="38e6e339-8bee-4322-9e67-b93ac19697b7" href="https://linear.app/ecos-ops/issue/ECO-97/build-8-sense-action-envelope-lifecycle-qualify-the-first-bounded">ECO-97</issue>; BUILD_CHECKOUT; `docs/build-contract.md`; `docs/invariants.md`; `docs/open-apertures.md`; BUILD 7 receipts 027/028/029 and <issue id="5bbbfe26-ff5d-43ae-ac2d-aa52b3aac14e" href="https://linear.app/ecos-ops/issue/ECO-94/build-7-shape-first-local-master-key-qualify-designate-recover">ECO-94</issue>/95/96; BUILD 7 migration and cold-output evidence; BUILD 6 receipts/remit; BUILD 0–5B receipts. Historical evidence consulted only after provisional derivation included <issue id="90f277ad-43e4-427f-9a31-77e853175608" href="https://linear.app/ecos-ops/issue/ECO-88/whole-ecosystem-descent-trace-preserved-obligations-into-usable">ECO-88</issue>, <issue id="8de56483-f9cd-42d5-bfeb-6c402a359663" href="https://linear.app/ecos-ops/issue/ECO-70/build-ssmm-spike-1-v02-durable-move-custody-field-proof">ECO-70</issue>, older SSMM slice/authority-integrity material, formal-semantics probe FS-0001, and an explicitly untracked local P2.0 projection-boundary harness. Historical material was treated as evidence rather than authority.

## D. Derive-before-encounter result

Before historical Action Envelope / SSMM material, the worker independently derived:

* gap after BUILD 7: orientation qualification/designation does not establish exact action permission or admission-to-effect accountability;
* minimum envelope function: preserve an exact bounded action with its legitimacy conditions and applicability;
* inherited prerequisites: active governance, qualified/designated orientation, independently supplied action authority, decision-bearing observations, bounded execution/recovery evidence;
* lifecycle responsibilities: bind; qualify; authorize/select; admit/invalidate; distinguish attempt/effect; recover and disposition another attempt;
* major unknowns: real authorities, observation guarantees, outcome/retry semantics; no demonstrated canonical-installation dependency;
* likely boundary: one synthetic state-sensitive action episode; no universal executor, policy engine, ontology, recursion, propagation, or final UX.

Historical material strengthened restoration/disconnection requirements, exact proposal binding, action-distinguishing paired-case pressure, and explicit execution-interval/evidence-return treatment. It did not change governing authority or justify importing legacy record types, nested loops, platform choices, or universal exactly-once claims.

## E. Known facts

1. BUILD 7 established C1 exact structural supply/local formation, C2 bounded semantic qualification, C3 separately authorized explicit designation against expected predecessor, and C4 exact cold recovery/requalification/re-keying.
2. Qualification supplies neither warrant nor authorization. BUILD 7 retained a false-PASS and bounded repair; arbitrary uninterpreted wording is not accepted as semantically qualified.
3. BUILD 7 designation implementation is synthetic-only and explicitly carries no execution authorization. Canonical installation would not itself create real designation authority.
4. BUILD 6 installed/proved protected bootstrap and first ordinary policy succession; accepted H/remit excludes arbitrary operational execution.
5. BUILD 5B proved exact retained representations and bounded checked transformations, not general external-effect proof or arbitrary action authority.
6. No governing source requires a separate Action Envelope currentness registry, universal compiler, executor topology, or action ontology.

Inference: the missing capability is the action-specific legitimacy/recovery connection, not another orientation mechanism or general operating system.

## F. Dependency ledger

* BUILD 6 protected human/governance authority within accepted remit — `AVAILABLE / CANONICAL`; supplies active governance/authority-effect distinction but not BUILD 8 action authority.
* BUILD 7 C1–C4 implementation — `IMPLEMENTED / NOT CANONICALLY INSTALLED`; usable for disposable composition.
* BUILD 7 positive designation fixtures — `SYNTHETIC-ONLY`.
* Canonical BUILD 7 installation for bounded proof — `NOT REQUIRED FOR BOUNDED BUILD 8`.
* Real Master-Key designation authority — `UNRESOLVED`.
* Real Master-Key designation/currentness — `UNRESOLVED`.
* Real action-specific authorization source — `UNRESOLVED`.
* Synthetic action-authority basis for proving — `SYNTHETIC-ONLY`; future fixture dependency, not already implemented grant.
* Exact operation, target, governing-basis addressability — `AVAILABLE / CANONICAL` structurally; BUILD 8 semantics still need qualification.
* BUILD 8-specific qualification/applicability contract — `UNRESOLVED`.
* Execution capability for bounded action — `UNRESOLVED`.
* Action-effect observation/recovery — `UNRESOLVED`.
* Real executor/runtime/deployment integration — `NOT REQUIRED FOR BOUNDED BUILD 8`.

Reusable closed-substrate work may travel structurally without importing its semantics: evidence capture/retrieval, Referent identity, Evidence Link revision distinction, `depends_on`, transition-history patterns, Artifact/checking patterns, protected decision versus execution, and BUILD 7 C1–C4 orientation handling.

## G. Proposed BUILD 8 capability boundary

Six behavioral responsibilities:

`R1 exact action/dependency binding`
→ `R2 bounded qualification`
→ `R3 applicable authorization and operative selection`
→ `R4 admission and continuing applicability`
→ `R5 attempt/result accountability`
→ `R6 cold recovery and further-attempt disposition`

R1–R6 are responsibilities, not mandated components, services, state-machine nodes, records, or tables.

The envelope must bind, directly or through exact recoverable references, the action meaning/permitted variation/intended effect; target identity and required target state/basis; scope/actor/execution-role constraints; governing orientation and its qualification/designation/current reliance conditions; authorization basis and applicable authority; constraints/exclusions/effect limits; temporal applicability/order/expiry/revocation/continuing-effect conditions; relevant evidence/assumptions/method versions; expected predecessor/prior attempts where consequential; required observations and limitations; and expected result/evidence plus conditions for another attempt.

Dependency-completeness rule: a dependency is required when varying it can change permission, safe admission, result interpretation, or another-attempt entitlement.

No separate envelope-currentness subsystem is independently earned for the first specimen. Operative selection may be carried by the same protected act as authorization only if designation/selection remains separately inspectable and newest-substitution is impossible.

## H. First bounded specimen class

One state-conditioned, non-idempotent logical action on a disposable synthetic target, with a maximum permitted effect of one occurrence.

Example class: one-unit advance of a disposable target, permitted only from an exact observed state under a synthetic orientation and independently supplied synthetic action authority.

Pressure variations must include correct/wrong actor/action/target/scope; changed orientation/evidence/predecessor/target state; expiry/revocation; competing attempts; failure before effect; effect followed by lost acknowledgement; genuinely unknown outcome; and cold recovery after initiating-context loss.

A read-only preview is too weak because it cannot pressure duplicate consequential effects. A real send/payment/deployment/governance succession/real designation is unnecessary and unauthorized.

Synthetic sufficiency rationale: the proof proposition is conditional on independently supplied governance/orientation/authority and observable target conditions; every decision-bearing input can be independently varied in disposable scope; real authority is needed only to establish a real grant, not to prove dependency on authority; effect/failure/acknowledgement distinctions can be inspected on a disposable target; therefore no bounded-proof step requires canonical BUILD 7 installation or real designation.

## I. Lifecycle responsibility contracts

### R1 — Exact proposed action + decision-bearing basis

Inputs: proposed action, exact target, governing orientation, declared dependency/constraint surface.

Required behavior: cold reviewer can recover what was proposed, permitted variation, and every dependency capable of changing the decision.

Do not collapse identity with state, representation with permission, or omission with irrelevance.

Missing required dependency, conflicting basis, or unresolved action meaning prevents positive qualification for consequential use; preserve proposal and gap.

Shape may choose representation, identity/version binding, retention, reference resolution, and narrowly earned substrate extension.

### R2 — Bounded qualification

Inputs: R1 material, independently inspectable obligations/comparison basis, identified method, relevant observations.

Required behavior: findings identify what was checked, against which inputs, with which limitations; decision-bearing prose and structured meaning cannot contradict unnoticed.

Validation does not confer warrant, authority, authorization, designation, currentness, or truth beyond checked proposition.

Contradiction, unsupported interpretation, missing evidence, or insufficient discrimination prevents positive eligibility and preserves uncertainty/findings.

Shape may choose bounded comparison method, evaluation representation, checker custody/enforcement, and negative controls; no arbitrary-language interpreter is required.

### R3 — Applicable action authorization + exact operative selection

Inputs: exact qualified envelope; separately supplied action authority/basis; actor, scope, operation, temporal conditions; predecessor/selection information where applicable.

Required behavior: recover who/what was entitled to permit the action, exact permission issued, and which envelope was selected as operative.

Qualification, BUILD 6 H identity, Master-Key designation, technical access, acceptance prose, or recency cannot manufacture action authority.

Missing/out-of-remit/withdrawn/expired/mismatched authority yields no applicable permission; history remains recoverable.

Shape may determine how authority evidence and operative selection are bound and whether one protected act co-instantiates authorization + designation while preserving both semantics.

### R4 — Execution admission + condition-specific applicability

Inputs: R3 permission; exact envelope; active governance/applicable orientation; sufficiently current observations; required execution guarantees; prior-attempt disposition.

Required behavior: a distinct admission decision identifies the conditions checked and each condition’s lawful applicability point/interval. Shape must derive whether a condition must hold at admission, effect/commit, continuously during an operation, or another decision-required temporal/order boundary. No universal rule requires every condition to remain true through effect.

Earlier validation/admission does not create perpetual permission; runtime capability does not create entitlement; admission is not attempt.

Observed drift, expiry, revocation, stale predecessor, unresolved ordering, or inadequate observation blocks only the action/effect whose declared contract requires that condition; historical legitimacy is not retroactively erased.

Shape may choose consistency/observation mechanisms, temporal/order handling, enforcement placement, and minimum disposable effect-boundary contract.

### R5 — Attempt / acknowledgement / effect evidence

Inputs: admission plus exact action-specific execution contract and bounded result/effect observation contract.

Required behavior: recover whether an attempt occurred, by whom/what, target, acknowledgement, and what effect is actually established.

Attempt ≠ effect; acknowledgement ≠ effect; producer success ≠ verified outcome or legitimacy.

Partial/conflicting/unknown observations remain explicit. Missing return cannot imply nothing happened. Unauthorized effects remain recorded as unauthorized effects.

Shape may choose attempt attribution/correlation, evidence capture, retention, observation, and failure-injection arrangements; it may specify required executor behavior without selecting a universal executor.

### R6 — Exact recovery + further-attempt entitlement

Inputs: retained R1–R5 history, current dependency observations, original continuation/retry limits, effect-recovery evidence.

Required behavior: cold reviewer distinguishes historical permission from present applicability, previous effect from unknown outcome, and continuation from newly requested action.

Retry does not automatically create new authorization; new request identity does not create entitlement; recovery is not execution.

Where prior effect/continuing permission cannot be established sufficiently to avoid excess effect, withhold another effectful attempt and preserve the recovery question.

Shape may choose reconstruction, operation correlation, duplicate suppression/reconciliation, and recovery evidence sufficient for the specimen.

## J. Boundary necessity/sufficiency

R1 is necessary because permission otherwise migrates to changed action/target state/scope.
R2 is necessary because well-formed representation can still misstate the permitted action.
R3 is necessary because qualified/capable must not become authorized by collapse.
R4 is necessary because permission applicable earlier can become inapplicable before a consequential boundary.
R5 is necessary because dispatch/acknowledgement must not be misreported as accomplishment.
R6 is necessary because crash/retry can create duplicate effect or rewrite history.

Each failure can occur in one non-recursive action on one target, so all precede BUILD 9/10. R1–R6 together cover what was proposed, why eligible, who could permit it, whether it could proceed, what was attempted, what happened, and whether further execution is permitted. A correct terminal result may be `unknown effect / no further attempt`.

Excluded and not required for first bounded episode: real Master-Key authority resolution, governance succession/remit enlargement, general policy engine, universal action ontology, arbitrary semantic interpretation, general executor topology, recursive planning, propagation, final UX, general compensation/disaster recovery, or a separate global envelope-currentness registry.

## K. Anti-collapse / adversarial obligations

Shape must preserve and later pressure at minimum:

* Master Key ≠ Action Envelope;
* envelope ≠ action/effect;
* proposal ≠ permission;
* qualification/validation ≠ warrant/authorization;
* correct action under wrong authority must refuse;
* authorized actor + wrong action/target/scope must refuse;
* authority ≠ technical capability/custody;
* changed Master Key/basis before a decision-required applicability point must trigger the declared requalification/invalidation behavior, not silent carry-forward;
* expiry/revocation constrains subsequent reliance according to temporal contract without erasing historical legitimacy;
* designation/currentness ≠ recency;
* admission ≠ attempt;
* attempt ≠ effect;
* effect ≠ acknowledgement;
* lost acknowledgement cannot justify blind replay;
* retry ≠ fresh authority and transport replay cannot mint extra entitlement;
* target identity ≠ target state;
* stable representation ≠ perpetual applicability;
* technical success does not retroactively legitimize unauthorized action;
* deployment ≠ authorization;
* synthetic authority cannot escape disposable scope;
* omission of a decision-bearing dependency must be exposed by paired cases;
* local specimen ≠ universal action ontology;
* concurrent attempts must preserve maximum permitted effect;
* partial/unknown failure must not erase observed partial effect or justify blind replay.

## L. Question Forward

Remain unresolved unless concrete evidence activates them:

 1. Real Master-Key designation authority — independently authorized source, actor, scope, temporal/revocation conditions.
 2. Canonical BUILD 7 installation — only if a later real consumer requires it; installation alone never supplies authority.
 3. Real action authorization — source permitted to authorize exact operation/target/limits.
 4. BUILD 6/action-authority relation — no automatic reuse or remit enlargement.
 5. Whether a separate envelope designation mechanism is independently needed — one protected authorization act may co-instantiate selection only while designation remains semantically recoverable.
 6. Retry mechanism details — no blind retry is fixed; exact effect-recovery evidence must be earned in Shape.
 7. Observation guarantees/races — each decision-bearing change must be detectable/enforceable at its declared applicability point.
 8. AP-10 — remains open/inactive unless an actual lossy-abstraction decision cannot be resolved without formal semantics.
 9. First consequential runtime/deployment coupling — excluded until material effect makes it decision-relevant.
10. Broader semantics/policy/ontology — excluded until indispensable specimen pressure activates them.
11. Representation/retention choices — Shape earns minimum recovery closure.
12. General executor/compensation/disaster recovery — excluded until unavoidable external-service/partial-effect pressure appears.
13. Recursion/propagation — excluded unless the episode cannot safely terminate/remain unresolved without a new scope.
14. Final UX — excluded; cold-review legibility is required but persistent interface architecture is not.
15. Proof generalization — false PASS/new action class/method change/broader reliance reopens affected proof claim.

## M. Shape entitlement candidate

After separate explicit authorization, Shape may choose the minimum concrete realization of R1–R6 for the bounded disposable specimen; freeze exact specimen semantics/constraints/comparison basis/synthetic fixtures; choose representation/identity/version/reference/retention; decide whether one protected act co-instantiates authorization and designation while keeping both meanings inspectable; define observation/temporal/concurrency/invalidation/retry mechanisms; specify disposable executor/effect-observer contract; declare enforcement modes/surfaces; freeze observable acceptance obligations; and define intelligible cold recovery.

Shape must distinguish accepted behavioral requirement, selected implementation, and future proof claim.

## N. Shape non-entitlement candidate

Shape may not invent real designation/action authority or enlarge BUILD 6 remit; create a real Master-Key designation; install BUILD 7 canonically; authorize real effects; treat synthetic governance as real governance; collapse qualification/custody/currentness/execution success into permission; select a general executor/runtime topology, deployment platform, policy engine, or universal action ontology; assume arbitrary semantic interpretation; activate AP-10 by resemblance; import legacy phase machinery as requirement; implement BUILD 9/10/final UX; erase unknown outcomes; invent retry/compensation authority; or silently change this boundary when physical design exposes an upstream dependency.

## O. Human adjudication at worker return

None required to complete the candidate. The evidence-supported disposition is a synthetic substrate proof with real-authority questions preserved. Requiring real designation/canonical installation first would become necessary only if an acceptance proposition actually depended on canonical authority or a real external effect; no such dependency was found.

## P. Worker return status

`SENSE CLOSURE CANDIDATE — READY FOR HUMAN REVIEW`
